row.proto: void Calc(void *calendar, uint32_t minutes, uint32_t *entry_idx, uint32_t *minute_in_entry)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Maps a minute timestamp to (calendar entry index, minute within entry): walks calendar vector (calendar+8, stride 0x10), converts entry timestamps with Ne_Crt_DiffClock into days*0x5a0 (1440 min/day). Hook value: the career date arithmetic; used by driver age and advance cards.

verify.notes: V9665 Accumulates per-entry day lengths (x 0x5a0 minutes) and returns entry index plus minutes within entry.
